title: Artificial Intelligence Senior Consultant
job_description: Role: AI Assurance Consultant About the job We are seeking a motivated AI Assurance Senior Consultant to join our team in Singapore within our Assurance division, focused on transforming how organisations identify, assess, and manage AI risks and assurance. Through hands-on client work and close collaboration with senior experts, you will gain critical, in-demand knowledge on how organisations adopt AI safely, compliantly, and at scale, covering AI risk, quality, governance, and regulatory alignment in real-world environments. Key Responsibilities Apply Deloitte’s Trustworthy AI methodology and solution to support AI Governance and Assurance in client environments, aligning deliverables with recognised frameworks and standards (e.g. NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) Identify and document risks related to bias, fairness, transparency, robustness, security, and privacy across AI use cases Support the development and maintenance of client AI risk registers and mitigation plans Prepare clear, structured AI risk and quality reports and assessment outputs for clients, with review and oversight from senior consultants Support client gap analyses and remediation roadmaps aligned with regulatory and standards-based expectations Contribute to the documentation of AI risk and control frameworks for client organisations Support client interactions by preparing materials and contributing to workshops, briefings, and structured discussions Support the design and implementation of AI governance programmes using Deloitte’s Trustworthy AI methodology. Assist in gap analysis and assessing AI risk, quality, and responsible AI policies and guidelines tailored to client needs Participate in client training sessions and internal solution and methodology development initiatives Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Law, Business, Risk Management, Public Policy, Ethics, or a related field A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage but not required Min 4 years of experience in consulting, risk management, compliance, legal, technology, or related client-facing roles Experience supporting client delivery, advisory, or assurance engagements Exposure to areas such as data governance, privacy, IT audit, cybersecurity, or technology risk Experience drafting professional client deliverables, reports, or advisory documentation Foundational knowledge of AI/ML concepts and lifecycles, with awareness of key AI risks (bias, explainability, data quality, security), data governance and protection principles, and major AI regulations and frameworks, alongside familiarity with relevant ISO standards as a plus Strong analytical and critical thinking skills Clear, confident written and verbal communication with clients
